result.summary: Found several visual issues: truncated restaurant name mid-word in the horizontal list, an empty profile avatar control, and a cut-off category chip with weak scroll affordance.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card and its title are clipped by the screen edge, leaving the name as 'Trattoria Piccol' mid-word with no ellipsis inside the card bounds.
issues.suggestion: Give each carousel card a fixed width so titles fit or truncate with an ellipsis (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccola…'), and ensure partial off-screen cards don’t hard-clip mid-character.

issues.description: The top-right profile control is an empty gray circle with only a red notification dot, so it looks unfinished or broken rather than like a profile entry point.
issues.suggestion: Show a default user avatar/icon inside the circle and keep the notification badge positioned on the avatar.

issues.description: The category chip row ends with a thin sliver of the next pill on the right, which looks like a broken or half-rendered control rather than intentional overflow.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal scroll affordance (fade, peek width, or padding) so partial chips read as scrollable content, not a layout glitch.

issues.description: Restaurant titles in the horizontal list can be cut off without a consistent truncation pattern, which hurts scannability next to fully visible neighbors.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single-line title style with ellipsis and sufficient max width on all cards in the row.
